'''Sector 5-7''' was a sector on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. An [[Unidentified Ewok village (Sector 5-7)|Ewok village]] was located in the sector in which a minor [[Skirmish on Endor (Recon-A)|skirmish]] took place.
